WorldDesc: The clover's already brought a little luck, just by turning out the way it did.

WorldDesc: A commemorative sculpture carefully crafted by Stellar Entertainment to honor players' outstanding performance in Chain Decoding. "Connect the patterns and master the rhythm!"

Name: Thank You for Your Snapshot
Desc: A decoration that can be placed on the photo wall in the  Commandant's lounge.
WorldDesc: Thank you for the snapshot. This thank-you gift was specially sent by the Engineering Force. Though honestly, it looks more like an ad for Kuroro Gym. The signature reads...\\n"When are you finally going to make up your mind about that request? —Karenina"\\nIs anyone actually taking this seriously?
LockDesc: Obtained by participating in [Will Under the Lens].

Name: Exclusive Gravity
Desc: A decoration that can be placed on the photo wall in the  Commandant's lounge.
WorldDesc: Opposite to gravity itself, there's a gravitational wave that exists only between you and them.

Name: Supply Master
Desc: A decoration that can be placed on the photo wall in the  Commandant's lounge.
WorldDesc: A commendation for collecting all supply crates in the Commercial District.
LockDesc: Obtained by participating in [Supply Crate Collection].

Name: F.O.S. Heritage Medal
Desc: A decoration that can be placed on the photo wall in the  Commandant's lounge.
WorldDesc: A medal awarded for distinguished service.\\nThe flame at its center was first lit when F.O.S. was founded. Through every separation and every return, it never truly went out. This medal belongs to those who carried that flame back into the sky. As long as someone chooses to protect it, the ember will keep burning.
LockDesc: Obtained by participating in [Homecoming and A New Journey].

Name: Supply Instructor
Desc: A decoration that can be placed on the photo wall in the  Commandant's lounge.
WorldDesc: To support daily maintenance and training across the training zones, the college's logistics department regularly delivers supply pods to designated stations for students to use as needed.
LockDesc: Obtained by participating in [Supply Crate Collection].

Name: Epic Bad Review!!!
Desc: A memorable photo that can be placed on the photo wall in the Commandant's lounge.
WorldDesc: A "bad review" note left behind by Pete. However, it seems like his previous positive comment haven't been completely erased yet.

Name: Detective Maru Is in Position, Bear
Desc: A memorable photo that can be placed on the photo wall in the Commandant's lounge.
WorldDesc: Detective Maru is in position and ready to take on your commissions at any time, bear!

Name: Prosperity Begins Here
Desc: A memorable photo that can be placed on the photo wall in the Commandant's lounge.
WorldDesc: New stores have been built along the street, replacing the starlight of night with their neon signs. The once-quiet streets now bustle with activity. The construction proceeds in an orderly fashion. Prosperity begins here.
LockDesc: Obtained by participating in [Business Development Plan].

Name: Midst the Festival's Revelry
Desc: A memorable photo that can be placed on the photo wall in the Commandant's lounge.
WorldDesc: Crowds surge and joyful sounds never cease. The persistence and hard work of the past have created this magnificent spectacle of brilliant lights.
LockDesc: Obtained by participating in [Business Development Plan].

Name: Under the Starlight
Desc: A memorable photo that can be placed on the photo wall in the Commandant's lounge.
WorldDesc: A photo of the starry sky taken through a porthole, where the radiance of countless stars shines exceptionally clear. "We gaze up at the stars, and from this moment, fear not the darkness of night."

Name: Not for Release - Moment Before the Mirror
Home
Desc: A memorable photo that can be placed on the photo wall in the Commandant's lounge.
WorldDesc: Inside the window or beyond it, both are home.

Name: Starwhisper Guardian
Desc: A memorable photo that can be placed on the photo wall in the Commandant's lounge.
WorldDesc: Together, we safeguarded the echoes of blessings drifting through the sea of stars.

Name: Art Collection
Desc: A memorable photo that can be placed on the photo wall in the Commandant's lounge.
WorldDesc: Lucia's Froggie drawing has been praised as "vivid and adorable." She came to the art gallery specifically to improve her skills. Encouraging her is also part of a Commandant's duty.

Name: Immersive Viewing
Desc: A memorable photo that can be placed on the photo wall in the Commandant's lounge.
WorldDesc: Teddy sometimes tests her "new toys" at the Babylonia Universal Cinema. Drop by if you want to see how it's going.

Name: On Stage and Off
Desc: A memorable photo that can be placed on the photo wall in the Commandant's lounge.
WorldDesc: Vera is often mistaken for one of the performers, and people frequently ask her for autographs. Maybe you could ask her for one too?

Name: Sagittarius and Flowers
Desc: A memorable photo that can be placed on the photo wall in the Commandant's lounge.
WorldDesc: Greenery is a luxury in Arctic regions, and that's exactly what makes it so beautiful. Rosetta often comes here to think. If you have time, you might hear some of her stories from the Arctic.

Name: Familiar Ground
Desc: A memorable photo that can be placed on the photo wall in the Commandant's lounge.
WorldDesc: Maybe the ice cream really was that good that day. Lee often chooses this place to unwind. Life keeps changing, but thankfully, the people around us stay the same.

Name: Wanshi's Odd Jobs
Desc: A memorable photo that can be placed on the photo wall in the Commandant's lounge.
WorldDesc: Wanshi's Odd Jobs exists to help whenever people run into trouble.\\nWanshi is such a gentle soul.

Name: Life
Desc: A memorable photo that can be placed on the photo wall in the Commandant's lounge.
WorldDesc: And so, a promise was made with Bianca to admire the flowers together every spring. Life works that way—once spring's wishes come true, we begin to long for summer's. The seasons turn, year after year.

Name: Keep Comms Open
Desc: A memorable photo that can be placed on the photo wall in the Commandant's lounge.
WorldDesc: Asimov assigns different notification tones to different contacts as a basic priority system. But who he replies to first is purely a matter of personal favo—no, personal feeling.

Name: Simulation Battle
Desc: A memorable photo that can be placed on the photo wall in the Commandant's lounge.
WorldDesc: Your mock battle with Harley Jo drew crowds of students eager to learn and observe. They even managed to capture the most spectacular moments of the fight.\\n"Huh? Where did that data come from?"

Name: Unfinished Puzzle
Desc: A memorable photo that can be placed on the photo wall in the Commandant's lounge.
WorldDesc: A code no one could read, a man's lifelong quest to decipher it.\\nHe thought his efforts would bring wealth—a gift from his father hidden in the solution. But the answer was not what he hoped for, and he could not accept it.\\nBecause acceptance would mean admitting that every detour he'd taken was a path someone else had laid out for him.\\nSo when humanity finally solves that ancient puzzle before us, what then?\\nPerhaps the truth is in plain sight. It's just that humanity isn't ready yet.

Name: Lingering Shadow
Desc: A memorable photo that can be placed on the photo wall in the Commandant's lounge.
WorldDesc: A terminal left forgotten in the campus holds records of the aloof figure.\\nNo one could truly approach her battlefield—even standing beside her became an impossible dream. But you always somehow manage to break through, and in those fleeting anomalies, your fingertips briefly touch that cold, ethereal shadow—
LockDesc: Obtained by participating in [Destined Moments - F.O.S.].

Name: Just One Victory
Desc: A memorable photo that can be placed on the photo wall in the Commandant's lounge.
WorldDesc: Vanessa's uniform is pressed as straight as her spine. Every intricate, perfect detail is rooted in her thorough preparation.\\nYet, she considers the effort behind it all beneath mention—just like this rehearsal. Vanessa firmly believes that people only need to see the right side of things. She knows she always has.
LockDesc: Obtained by participating in [Destined Moments - F.O.S.].

Name: Another Sun
Desc: A memorable photo that can be placed on the photo wall in the Commandant's lounge.
WorldDesc: Just as the sun, Kamui never hesitates to share his light and warmth with the world.\\nThe names he has spoken are certainly engraved within his soul, ever marching onward.
LockDesc: Obtained by participating in [Destined Moments - F.O.S.].

Name: Youthful Days
Desc: A memorable photo that can be placed on the photo wall in the Commandant's lounge.
WorldDesc: Chrome has no regrets about his choices—those experiences shaped who he is today.\\nThe past was filled with hardship. Only by gracefully letting go of yesterday can one truly spend each day with those beside them and march toward the future.
LockDesc: Obtained by participating in [Destined Moments - F.O.S.].

Name: Respite
Desc: A memorable photo that can be placed on the photo wall in the Commandant's lounge.
WorldDesc: Liv is curious about everything here, where you once lived.\\nConsider this brief respite in your old seat as Liv's little indulgence to mark the final stop of today's journey.
LockDesc: Obtained by participating in [Destined Moments - F.O.S.].

Name: Substitute Teacher
Desc: A memorable photo that can be placed on the photo wall in the Commandant's lounge.
WorldDesc: Aboard the ship where everything is being rebuilt, Nirvatia would stand at high vantage points, scanning for every possible safety hazard.\\nWhile using her knowledge to provide the greatest assistance to F.O.S., she hasn't forgotten to look after her little raven.
LockDesc: Obtained by participating in [Destined Moments - F.O.S.].

Name: Outstanding Commissioner
Desc: An ornament that can be placed on the display shelf in the Commandant's lounge.
WorldDesc: An honor trophy symbolizing outstanding contribution, awarded to Chief Commissioners who exceeded the Commercial Square Development Plan objectives.
LockDesc: Obtained by participating in [Business Development Plan].

Name: Coffee Beans Can Bloom Too
Desc: An ornament that can be placed on the display shelf in the Commandant's lounge.
WorldDesc: A handmade coffee bean wreath crafted by Ross. Get close and you can smell the subtle coffee aroma. It's said to bring good luck.

Name: Old Place, New Journey
Desc: An ornament that can be placed on the display shelf in the Commandant's lounge.
WorldDesc: Let's go, Commandant! A new adventure has begun, and more surprises are waiting for you to discover!

Name: Froggie Plushie
Desc: An ornament that can be placed on the display shelf in the Commandant's lounge.
WorldDesc: A collector's edition Froggie plushie. Gently press its belly and it'll make cute "ribbit" sounds.
LockDesc: Obtained by participating in [Whispers of Love Story - Lucia].

Name: Feel It, Record It
Desc: An ornament that can be placed on the display shelf in the Commandant's lounge.
WorldDesc: Watch a flower bloom at its own pace. Catch the shifting light along the terminator line. Smell paint on canvas, oil on gears, dew on grass. Feel the world. Record life.
LockDesc: Obtainable by participating in [Operation Guide II].

Name: Blast Drone Gen III Model
Desc: An ornament that can be placed on the display shelf in the Commandant's lounge.
WorldDesc: A drone model Karenina made after the mission and gifted to the Gray Raven Commandant. According to her, it's just something she put together "on a whim."

Name: Honor Pedestal
Desc: An ornament that can be placed on the display shelf in the Commandant's lounge.
WorldDesc: A pedestal that holds medals and ribbons.\\nThough it has no voice, this stand has witnessed every ounce of significance that Babylonia has lost and reclaimed.
LockDesc: Obtained by participating in [Operation Guide III].
